name: Contact List
summary: Adversaries may utilize standard operating system APIs to gather contact list data. On Android, this can be accomplished using the Contacts Content Provider. On iOS, this can be accomplished using the `Contacts` framework. If the device has been jailbroken or rooted, an adversary may be able to access the Contact List without the user’s knowledge or approval.
